question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Beloved, Bob gets Jane Eyre, and Claire gets Emma.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Bob and Alice swap books. Finally, Claire and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Beloved
(B) Jane Eyre
(C) Emma
solution:
Books in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (Beloved, Jane Eyre, Emma)
After Claire and Bob swap: (Beloved, Emma, Jane Eyre)
After Bob and Alice swap: (Emma, Beloved, Jane Eyre)
After Claire and Bob swap: (Emma, Jane Eyre, Beloved)
Claire has Beloved, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
